name: Salvatore!
source:
Nagaoka Shou is a member of the Hayakawa Academy cheer leading squad. Recognized for his outstanding cheering skills its said that he would certainly be the next leader. But when the offer came he turned it down because he was going to Europe on a student exchange program.

One year later, Nagaoka is back but the cheerleader squad is in shambles. In order to convince the school to support the squad he starts gathering random members, regardless of their cheer leading experience.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=220193]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
长冈翔是早川学园应援团的一员。凭借出色的助威能力，他被公认为下一任团长的不二人选。然而，任命到来时，他却拒绝了，因为自己即将作为交换生前往欧洲。

一年后，长冈回到学校，应援团却已濒临瓦解。为了说服校方继续支持社团，他开始四处招募成员，不论对方是否有助威经验。

[翻译自[url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=220193]Getchu[/url]]
